effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Reptile] or [Dragonkin] trait and 1 card with the [LIBERATOR] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your opponent's security stack is removed from, gain 1 memory.
